correctness.rationale: Existence of stationary pair follows from a two-sided regenerative Brownian driver and a stable linear filter. The independent 265-check Python script reproduces exact rational moments and finite ODE values, but universal assertions rest on the proof.

value.rationale: Quadratic energy autocovariance is a natural physical relaxation statistic, not an arbitrary parameter slice. Its complete exact lag dependence, strictly positive kernel, sharp switching threshold at r=2mu, and critical uniform profile distinguish memory-induced and trapping-induced relaxation, beyond one-time moments and second-order position correlations.
